concerns.text: FR-004 requires covariate adjustment (e.g., via ANCOVA or regression‑based residualization) but US2’s acceptance criteria then apply Mann‑Whitney U tests on the adjusted features. Using a non‑parametric rank‑based test after residualizing for covariates is statistically inconsistent; ANCOVA already provides a parametric test that accounts for covariates, while Mann‑Whitney assumes raw, unadjusted data. This mismatch may invalidate p‑values and effect‑size estimates.

Success Criterion SC-001 demands at least one feature to be statistically significant after Bonferroni correction, yet the ADReSS dataset contains only a few hundred participants (≈170–400). No power analysis is provided to justify that this sample size can reliably detect group differences given the multiple‑testing correction. Without a priori power calculation, the criterion is unrealistic and the study may be under‑powered, compromising the validity of any null findings.
